title: Clarify locale-safe DateFormula Evaluate inputs
summary: Adds a Microsoft Style article clarifying that DateFormula Evaluate calls require language-independent literals to work correctly in non-English localizations, addressing a localization gap where such calls could fail despite correct downstream CalcDate typing.
key_points: New style guide article explains the localization issue with Evaluate and DateFormula
Demonstrates the problem with paired bad/good examples in AL code
Includes references to existing BaseApp scheduling patterns using invariant input
Deliberately scoped to exclude form mechanics, trigger prohibitions, and unresolved schema themes
Validation confirms 308 articles, 509 samples, and 72 fixtures pass all checks
